label: Odd-Jobs $50 for the Pot
description: Before the next draft, Loser earns $50 for the league pot by doing odd jobs for willing neighbors, posting a photo of each job and a weekly check-in in the league chat.

label: Winner's Four-Station Gauntlet
description: The winner presides over a four-station gauntlet in Loser's driveway: 40 squats, 25 push-ups, 15 burpees, and a 60-second plank. A video of each station goes in the league chat.

label: Nightly Dance Practice Clips
description: After bedtime each night this week, Loser posts a 20-second clip of himself learning a dance routine, and the final take goes in the league chat.

label: Litter Museum Curator Tour
description: Loser collects litter on his street for 20 minutes, then films a museum-curator tour of his finds in a hushed voice. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Winner's Language League Address
description: Winner picks a language Loser doesn't speak, and Loser spends the week learning to give a 60-second league announcement in it. He delivers it on a league video call, and the recording goes in the group chat.

label: Oversized Check Ceremony
description: Loser makes a poster-board check for $30, then presents it, along with real $30, to the winner with a 60-second speech at a ceremony the winner presides over. A photo goes in the league chat.

label: Winner's Yoga Pose Challenge
description: Winner picks a yoga pose and a hold time between 30 and 60 seconds. Loser films his best attempt after five practice tries, and the video goes in the league chat.

label: Top 5 Most Embarrassing Moments
description: After bedtime, Loser posts a ranked list of his five most embarrassing moments with a one-line review each, and reads number one aloud on video. Both go in the league chat.

label: Winner's Chore, Ridiculous Hat
description: Winner picks one small chore at Loser's own home, and Loser does it after bedtime wearing a ridiculous hat the winner picks. A before and after photo goes in the league chat.

label: Winner's Season Storybook
description: Loser writes and illustrates a five-chapter storybook about the winner's season and reads one chapter a day on video, in a narrator voice the winner picks. Each video goes in the league chat.
